questions.question: What is the speed limit in a residential area if no other speed is posted?
questions.correctAnswerText: 25 miles per hour
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a residential area is 25 miles per hour unless a different speed is posted.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane and want to move to the left lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you
Look over your left shoulder for traffic in your blind spot
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no vehicles are in the lane you want to enter. Always signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection
Yield only to traffic on the right
Yield only to traffic on the left
Slow down and let other traffic go first

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can continue through or exit from your current lane
You can stay in your lane and continue through
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your current lane does not continue through the interchange. It becomes an exit ramp. You must either change lanes or exit the freeway.

questions.question: What is important to do when changing lanes?

options.text: Make sure the lane is clear

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Make sure the new lane is clear before you move into it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about road conditions ahead
Helps you find cities and towns ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road conditions ahead
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They warn you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: You have a green light but pedestrians are crossing against the red. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of them
Stop and let them cross safely
Drive close to them to scare them

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let them cross safely
questions.explanation: Always be careful around pedestrians. Stop and let them cross safely, even if you have a green light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead. Be alert and watch for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Watch carefully for traffic crossing from the sides.

questions.question: You are driving slowly and traffic is backing up behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass
Do not let other cars pass you

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is unsafe. If traffic is backing up behind you on a two-lane road, pull off the road to let vehicles pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: One-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street. Drivers must obey this sign.

questions.question: If an approaching train is near enough or going fast enough to be a danger, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find an alternative route across tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is near or moving fast enough to be dangerous, do not cross. This is true even if there are no signals or gates.

questions.question: When you are in a line of traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto the tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely. Never pass other vehicles at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: Road rage and aggressive driving can be reduced by:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, use turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time for your trip.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while you are driving. You should:

options.text: Hold your steering wheel tightly and slow to a stop.
Turn on your emergency flashers and continue driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold your steering wheel tightly and slow to a stop.
questions.explanation: Do not brake suddenly. Grip the steering wheel firmly and stay in your lane. Release the accelerator and slow down gradually. Once you are moving slowly, apply the brakes gently and pull to a safe area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: Highway signs that warn about dangerous conditions are called:
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about possible hazards ahead. Follow warning signs for your safety. Ignoring a warning sign can cause an accident.

questions.question: Child restraints are required for:

options.text: Infants and children under age 4 or weighing less than 40 pounds.
All children if the driver is their parent or guardian.
All children seated in the front seat.
All children under age 6 when airbags are not available.

questions.correctAnswerText: Infants and children under age 4 or weighing less than 40 pounds.
questions.explanation: Children under age 4 or weighing less than 40 pounds must use an approved child safety seat. Children ages 4 to 8 must use a booster seat, unless they are 4'9" or taller.

questions.question: When you see other drivers acting angrily:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: When other drivers are angry, stay away from them physically and mentally. Avoid eye contact and body movements that could upset them. Slow down, move over, or do whatever keeps you safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the speed shown on the sign for safe driving.

questions.question: A driver license applicant under age ____ must have permission from a parent or legal guardian.
questions.explanation: If you are under 18, a parent or legal guardian must sign your driver license application.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means "stop." You must stop completely. Wait for other vehicles and pedestrians to clear the way before you go.

questions.question: If traffic lights are not working due to a power outage:

options.text: Park your vehicle off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat it as a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it as a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection like a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers as you would at a four-way stop, then proceed with care when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop or swerve, so you must let them pass before crossing.

questions.question: You are driving at night and another vehicle is coming toward you. Your headlights should be:

options.text: On either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: On low beam.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is coming toward you or when you are following another vehicle. Use low beam to keep everyone safe.
